questions.question: Explain what the equator is and how it divides the Earth.
questions.expected_answer: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the Earth, halfway between the North Pole and the South Pole. It divides the Earth into two halves, the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere.

questions.question: Name the seven continents and say which is the biggest and which is the smallest.
questions.expected_answer: Africa, Asia, Antarctica, Australia, Europe, North America and South America. Asia is the biggest and Australia is the smallest.

questions.question: Name the five oceans and the two oceans on South Africa's coast.
questions.expected_answer: The Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern and Arctic Oceans. South Africa has the Atlantic Ocean on its west coast and the Indian Ocean on its east coast.
